proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9361.2 bhagna explicitly derives run/flee stems through Prakrit bhagga “broken, fled”, with Hindi bhāgnā and Old Marwari bhāgaï “runs”. The article retains the debated relation between breaking and fleeing; this selects the g-stem branch.
